outlook.statement: The NBFC outlook for FY 2025-26 projects a steady loan book growth of 15-17%. While softer borrowing costs from RBI rate cuts will help margins, elevated credit costs and stricter RBI regulations will weigh on near-term profitability, prompting lenders to focus on secured segments like gold and property loans.
